messages:
jun: Heads-up — we just noticed a ~3x spike in the recompute backfill queue for hourly aggs. Looks like a late-event surge from EU ingest (roughly 11:04–11:12 UTC). Thinking of a conservative "fast-path" reslice for KV cache resync that does smaller sharded windows to avoid long-running slots. Want to align on routing, quotas, and how we expose this in the console before we flip anything.
elaine: +1 to conservative approach. Can you quantify 'smaller'? also we need a safe fallback if dedupe/unordered events make reslices produce duplicates.
mike: Numbers? how many shards would this create, expected throughput, and token estimate? if concurrency x shards > capacity we'll thrash.
sarah: From console UX side — if we expose a fast-path toggle it needs: token/compute estimate, expected ETA, and an opt-in canary slice. Also a preempt button so SREs can stop mid-run.
jun: quick sketch of config i'm thinking of:
```
{
  "recompute_policy": "conservative-reslice",
  "shard_window_minutes": 6,
  "concurrency_per_tenant": 8,
  "dedupe_window_ms": 120000,
  "priority_lane": "fastpath-evictable"
}
```
edges: smaller windows = more tasks but shorter KV locks.
devops-bot: queue-size: 2,400 tasks; avg task duration: 14m; current avg concurrency: 120; infra headroom (dedicated pools): 40 slots free.
jun: want routing guidance — route to Dedicated to preserve SLA-sensitive tenants, host the low-priority ones on shared. But if dedicated is saturated, fallback to cheaper quantized variants? thoughts?
elaine: prefer policy: tenant.sla == enterprise => prefer Dedicated; else route by cost-band and age-of-event (newer late events get higher priority). implement as a scoring function in router.
mike: Agree. Also add a per-tenant windowed quota that caps total concurrent reslice tasks. Example: `max_reslice_tasks = max(2, floor(commit_tier * 0.1))` so small tenants don't blow up.
sarah: For console: wire up an endpoint that returns ETA + token estimate per planned reslice. UI should show 'canary slice' link and live progress stream. Also add a tooltip explaining dedupe risk and cost delta.
jun: operational concerns: 1) dedupe safety — we'll run idempotent upserts and a final consistency pass for overlapping windows, 2) throttles — we'll enforce a cluster-level rate limiter per priority_lane, 3) billing — surface projected token cost and allow owners to cancel.
elaine: fallback behaviour: if fallback to quantized variant, we should mark results as "best-effort" in the aggregate metadata and trigger a post-run regression eval.
mike: small ops command to drain fast-path if needed:
```
# drain fastpath lane
kubectl annotate job -l priority=fastpath evict=true --overwrite
```
jun: ok action list: (a) elaine to draft routing scoring fn PR, (b) mike to add tenant quota cap + preemption hook, (c) sarah to mock console fast-path panel with ETA/token display, (d) ops to add a Canary slice run for EU surge. I'll kick off a short dry-run with shard_window_minutes=6, concurrency_per_tenant=4 and watch cost.
sarah: i'll add a small copy blurb: "Fast-path reslices trade higher parallelism for shorter task duration; may produce duplicates if late events overlap — system runs idempotent upserts by default." :warning:
jun: thanks — starting dry-run in 10. i'll post results and metrics here. @devops-bot plz ping when queue drops below 800 or when dedicated headroom falls under 8 slots.
devops-bot: ack — will notify on thresholds (<800 queued, dedicated headroom <8).
